title: Jesus... I'm The Strong One For Everyone And I'm So Tired
topic: always being the strong friend everyone leans on

bible.text: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I'm the strong one for everyone, and I'm so tired. 😭

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Tonight I cried in the bathroom so nobody would hear.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I heard you in that bathroom. You don't have to be quiet with Me.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I fall apart, who holds everyone else together?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were never meant to hold everyone together. Strong people get carried too.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put it down. I've got you, and I've got them.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who always checks on everyone else.
